description.narrative: The Overall Objective is to contribute to the promotion and protection of human rights and fundamental freedoms in Sri Lanka and the Specific Objective is Strengthen women-led promotion and protection of the freedoms of a) expression and information, b) assembly and association and c) thought, conscience and religion, in Sri Lanka. The Intermediate Outcomes are:1.Womens groups are empowered to lead awareness-raising campaigns for informing public opinion and lobby key decision makers on fundamental freedoms.2.Women-led activities sensitize communities and lobby local and national government authorities to help promote and defend the citizens fundamental freedoms.3.The youth display an increased understanding of the role that freedom of thought, conscience and religion, play in building a peaceful and pluralistic society.
